links.outcome: Accuracy, completeness and hallucination Likert scores of LLM clinical evidence synopses rated by hematologists
links.effect: No LLM achieved perfect accuracy, completeness or relevance; hallucination scores ranged from 4.00 (Claude) to 1.92 (Llama); all outputs needed expert editing.
links.quote: Claude performed at a consistently higher level than other LLMs, all tested LLMs required careful editing from a domain expert to become usable.

links.outcome: Head-to-head comparison of four LLMs on the same synopsis task across quality domains
links.effect: Claude outperformed others (accuracy 3.92 vs ChatGPT 3.25, Gemini 3.17, Llama 1.92); Llama performed considerably poorer across all domains.
links.quote: Llama performed considerably poorer across all the studied domains.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of four off-the-shelf LLMs summarizing clinical evidence for cancer treatments, evaluated by expert hematologists, without testing an organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
